**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Contact | Pet Policy | |---------|---------|---------|------------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Miami Central Station)** | 1 Seaboard Ave, Miami, FL 33132 | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [Amtrak – Miami](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia) | • **Pets on Trains** – Small dogs and cats are allowed on Amtrak trains **only in a carrier** that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• **Service Animals** – Service animals are permitted in the station and on trains without a carrier.
• **Station Rules** – No pets are allowed in the station’s public areas unless they are service animals.
• **Additional Info** – The station is fully accessible and offers a dedicated “pet relief” area for service animals. | ### Why this station is the best choice - **Central Location** – Located just a few blocks from Miami International Airport and the downtown area, making it easy to reach from most parts of the city. - **Multi‑modal Hub** – Connects to Metrorail, Metromover, and local bus lines, so you can easily transfer to other transportation modes with your pet. - **Pet‑Friendly Amenities** – While the station itself does not have a dedicated pet lounge, it does allow service animals and provides a small area for them to relieve themselves. - **Clear Pet Policy** – Amtrak’s pet policy is straightforward: carriers for small pets, service animals allowed without carriers, and no pets in the station’s public spaces unless they are service animals. ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet 1. **Check the Carrier Size** – Make sure your pet’s carrier meets Amtrak’s size limits (under 18 inches tall, 18 inches long, and 12 inches wide). 2. **Bring Identification** – Keep your pet’s ID tags and a copy of their vaccination records handy. 3. **Plan for Breaks** – If you’re traveling a long distance, schedule stops at pet‑friendly hotels or parks along the route. 4. **Arrive Early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet and to find the designated pet relief area if needed. If you need more detailed information about the station’s layout, accessibility features, or additional pet‑friendly services, feel free to let me know!
